Goenka Group, New Delhi, offers a comprehensive and enriching educational experience. A competent faculty and a commitment to holistic development make it a top choice for affordable boarding in the region. GD Goenka, Rohtak, recognizes the importance of all-around development in the 21st century. A dedicated team of caretakers, wardens, supervisors, counselors, and pastoral care staff provides comprehensive support, creating a close-knit community. The school emphasizes social and leadership skills, promoting independent work, interpersonal skills, cooperation, and collaboration. GDGIS nurtures each child, providing excellent academic facilities and focusing on physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual development, with separate hostels for boys and girls. Boarders at GD Goenka, Rohtak, enjoy a safe, secure, and comfortable environment, fostering independence and responsibility. The supportive academic atmosphere motivates students to achieve their best. The school offers a unique opportunity for students to live and learn together. As a renowned international educational organization, GDGIS Rohtak provides quality education, preparing students for future success. The School moves beyond traditional teaching methods, offering a modern and effective approach to learning. The school focuses not only on academic excellence but also on character development, instilling social and ethical values and nurturing leadership qualities. GDGIS offers state-of-the-art infrastructure, from smart classrooms and well-equipped labs to art and activity halls, a music and dance academy, robotics labs, and comprehensive sports facilities with experienced coaches. GD Goenka offers a wide range of sports, including cricket, badminton, swimming, horse riding, shooting, fencing, gymnastics, tennis, football, skating, and boxing. The school also emphasizes moral and cultural values, creating a diverse and inclusive environment where students learn to respect and integrate different traditions.

name: Pathways World School
description: About Us Founded in 2003, Pathways World School was envisioned as a model of educational excellence — one that redefined schooling in India by introducing the International Baccalaureate (IB) Continuum from Early Years to the Diploma Programme. Pathways World School was built around the idea that true education goes beyond acquiring facts — it’s about learning to think, question, and make meaning. In a world overflowing with information, Pathways World School nurtures learners who can discern, analyze, and lead with wisdom. Our philosophy places the student at the centre of the learning journey. Drawing on Dr. Howard Gardner’s Multiple Intelligences framework, we recognize that intelligence is not one-dimensional — every learner possesses unique strengths that must be identified, valued, and developed. Learning at Pathways World School is hands-on, inquiry-driven, and collaborative. Classrooms become spaces of exploration, where teachers are facilitators of curiosity and students are empowered to construct knowledge, rather than simply receive it. This approach prepares them not just for academic achievement, but for life — as confident, compassionate, and self-directed lifelong learners. Set on a 32-acre LEED Platinum-certified campus in the serene foothills of the Aravalis — yet just 35 km from Delhi International Airport — the school offers flexible day and boarding options, including week, fortnight, and term boarding, providing the best of both worlds for modern families. Pathways World School combines world-class infrastructure with a culture of innovation, sustainability, and global-mindedness. Its award-winning campus has earned international recognition, including the Designshare Award (New York, 2003), the Best IT User Award by NASSCOM (2004), and distinction among the five best architectural works in Delhi NCR (2007). A global member of Round Square since 2010, the school reflects a strong commitment to international-mindedness and holistic education. Accredited by the Council of International Schools (CIS) and the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC), Pathways continues to set benchmarks for excellence and global citizenship. Most recently, the EducationWorld Survey ranked Pathways World School as the #1 “IVY League School of India” among over 4,500 schools nationwide - a testament to its sustained leadership, academic rigor, and future-focused vision.

name: Sehwag International School
description: About Us . Welcome to Sehwag International School (SIS), focusing on overall development for a better world SIS, founded by Mr. Virender Sehwag, aims at sculpting its student’s into responsible global citizens who constantly strive for perfection in every aspect of their lives. Perfection can only be a result of constant care, attention and perseverance (correction). Keeping this in mind SIS ensures that each student be dealt with the utmost patience and care, developing them into responsible global citizens. SIS offers day school and residential facilities to students from Grade 1 to Grade 12 and prepares them for the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). Our faculty consists of handpicked professionals who are the most competent and experienced in their fields. Our faculty is constantly developing novel methods to keep students motivated and realize their true potential. Moreover the one is to one mentoring ensures that each student excels in his strengths and is constantly improving his weaknesses. The focus at SIS is to offer 360° developments to students SIS thus focuses on every aspect of a student’s life, from academics to sports, to social skills, emotional and intellectual development. At SIS students are not just taught but trained to face the real world. Our comprehensive academic program goes beyond the 4 walls of a classroom and inculcates learning into our lives. It has been molded to empower students to think critically, synthesize knowledge and reflect on their own thought processes. Aiming at removing the fear of getting their feet wet in interdisciplinary thinking. Equipped with the most technologically advanced laboratories and classrooms, we ensure students receive a balance of theoretical and practical knowledge. Our advanced sports facilities and highly proficient faculty not only allows students to learn varied sports but also the spirit of sportsmanship. Our inter house disciplines and interschool competitions, combined with various cultural fests give students the exposure to develop their social and communication skills. While providing students with an international learning experience and developing globally minded students, we believe in preserving the core Indian values that define each of us. Defined by the Power of 7, the SIS fraternity lives upon the mantra of “Arise Awake Ascend”. Safe And Secure Environment SIS provides a safe and secure environment for its students with state-of-the-art security and monitoring system. Special procedures and systems are in place to perform a thorough background check of every staff member before hiring. To ensure safety of your child, as per our admissions policy, at the time of admission you will be asked to fill the “Authorized Persons to Pick up Your Child” form. Only persons nominated by you through this form will be allowed to pick up your child from the school. The SIS Staff will monitor all the arrivals and departures, thereby maintaining the highest levels of security at all times. Second Home The Hostel is equipped with air-conditioned rooms with attached bathrooms. The interiors have been designed to provide a balance between rest and study areas for the students. A committed House Master, like a parent, adds to the personal development of the resident students. The code of conduct based on the universal values of love, care and justice is followed at SIS. SIS has a state-of-the art kitchen to provide multi-cuisine dining with stress on quality, nutrition and hygiene. The food is prepared by expert cooks in a hygienic and spacious environment. The menu is prepared by an expert dietician to provide a balanced and healthy diet to young children.

description: About Us The future of education is the future of the human race. Education needs to look beyond literacy, academic skills, certification and qualification. description: About Us Rising Sun Public School is a well-known, premier, co-ed school in the region. Goenka World School, set against the picturesque foothills of the Aravalli Range, enjoys the benefits of advanced technology and world-class infrastructure: beautifully manicured lawns, a Wi-Fi enabled, fully-air-conditioned campus; meticulously maintained playing fields, activities and sporting facilities, with nationally-ranked programs (Education World 2013 -14), AV equipped classrooms and conference halls, well-stocked libraries, hi-tech laboratories, carefully planned residential accommodation and an exclusive dining experience. Goenka, tirelessly supported by the hands-on approach of Vice-Chairperson, Mrs Renu Goenka and the energetic marketing and financial expertise of the Managing Director, Mr. Nipun Goenka, believe that their journey into education has only just begun. Education World India School Rankings 2017-18, GDGWS is ranked among the country’s top 15 international day-cum-boarding schools and #2 in Delhi NCR. GDGWS awarded as Top Schools of India at 6th School Leadership summit 2018 by Elets, Digital Learning. IIRIS School Safety Award at Times Education Icons 2018 Event International School Award (2016-19) by British Council Member of The Association of International Schools of India (TAISI) The School has been felicitated for being ranked among the top 7 in the Times School Survey conducted in 2017 under International Curriculum category by Times Education Icons 2018 Progressive Principal Award by The Fifth Estate at National Convention of Education. Dr. Neeta Bali Director-Principal GDGWS felicitated by AKS Education awards (Alert Knowledge Services) at the event called ‘ 100 highly effective Principals of India’ for Jury’s Choice Award (2018). Learning is enabling the individual to utilize his/ her potential to its fullest. Without education, the development of the human mind is incomplete At G. D. This, coupled with a state-of- the-art technology, a highly qualified, thoroughly trained and concerned faculty, a plethora of activities for students to engage in -all provide an environment that’s both therapeutic and beautiful. As children go about discovering themselves, they also discover extraordinary roots, because another objective of the G. D. Goenka School is to ensure that the wards of NRIs and Persons of Indian origin abroad get an opportunity to reconnect with the culture and values that form the backbone of every Indian’s existence. To achieve these objectives, this unique educational institution seeks to blend the beauty of traditional cultural values with the latest in teaching aids and methodology to optimize learning, open young minds and empower young people to become global citizens who stand tall and live with courage and conviction, carving a niche for themselves wherever they go. In a safe, peaceful, disciplined and intellectually -challenging environment, all GDGWS students shall have ample opportunity to: Fulfil their academy, cultural, sporting and social potential Acquire skills of curiosity, collaboration, reflection, integrity, self-discipline, diligence and independence. Maintain openness of mind, dignity of conduct and mutual respect in the face of racial, economic, cultural, religious and linguistic diversity. Develop socially responsible and responsive global citizens. The G.D. Goenka Group G D Goenka World School

name: BRCM Gyankunj School
description: About Us BRCM Gyankunj School established in 1987 is located in the city of Bahal, Bhiwani (Haryana). The school has its own spirit, moral & ethics strongly imbibed from the renowned Chaudhary family of Bahal. BRCM Gyankunj School is marvel of modern attractive architecture and landscaping, located in the heart of small town Bahal in district Bhiwani. It has open green quiet environment having the richness of colorful flowers and green beautiful fields all around. The building articulates our philosophy, having exposed brickwork that blends with the natural surroundings. The school offers the students quality space that allows them to learn, reflect and grow in a healthy environment. It has well manicured lawns and proper waste and water disposal system that makes the school eco friendly. The Gyankunj School is a Co-Ed Day cum Boarding School managed by BRCM Education Society which is one of the best schools of the Bahal as well as in the district Bhiwani, Haryana. School is committed to build a strong foundation which enables every student to handle higher education of their choice under the able guidance of qualified & experienced teachers. In other words the world class infrastructure and amenities facilitates quality education and help the students to attain excellence in their chosen domain giving their learning a new meaning in this knowledge hub. Catering to the need of English medium education in this region, school provides quality education to the students in Commerce, Science & Humanities as per CBSE syllabus from I to XII. The school has a spectrum of Co-curricular and extracurricular activities, sports, creative arts, performing arts etc. which are the integral part of the students’ routine. A Dynamic School is, committed not only to provide the best possible education in and out of classrooms but also in developing global citizenship qualities in our students. Join us in our journey to shape future leaders and innovators and to continue creating a legacy of success, values and lifelong leaving.
